verdict: Meta is driving all leads; Google spend needs to earn its place.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 12 leads at an average cost of $195.79 per lead — all 12 came from Meta, which spent $641.67. Google Ads consumed $1,707.77 over the same window and logged 7 conversions, but those are not yet reconciling to tracked leads, making Meta roughly three times more efficient per dollar right now. Lead pace has been accelerating this week, averaging 2.3 leads per day over September 8–10 versus 1.0 per day the prior three days — a strong directional signal from Meta. We are reviewing Google's budget allocation and conversion tracking to ensure that spend is producing accountable results. Next week you should see continued Meta lead volume and a clearer picture of what Google is actually delivering.
